name: sol-advisor
description: Configurable Codex-only architect workflow with exact native roles and explicit opt-in GPT-5.6 Luna app tasks.

interface.shortDescription: Configure exact native roles or explicitly opt into Luna tasks.
interface.longDescription: Sol Advisor runs lazy parent-chat setup, stores non-secret exact role preferences, safely previews and installs Codex-native adapters, and preserves the explicit opt-in GPT-5.6 Luna / Max app-task lane through Codex app task tools. The parent owns architecture, diff verification, correction loops, and acceptance. The opt-in lane uses list_projects, list_threads, create_thread, wait_threads, read_thread, and send_message_to_thread.
defaultPrompt: Use Sol Advisor's configured native roles to build this feature, verify it, and obtain an independent advisor review before completion.
Use the Luna task lane only when I explicitly authorize it; create user-visible GPT-5.6 Luna / Max tasks through Codex app task tools and keep primary review and acceptance in this task.
